allies.rationale_text: Active-listening helps constructive-feedback-models land because the receiver is more likely to hear correction when they feel accurately understood.
allies.affinity_rationale: Relational foundation — 'care personally' — active listening creates the trust and attention that makes feedback receivable, but operates as a social prerequisite rather than a feedback-specific mechanism.
allies.activation_condition: When feedback delivery requires demonstrating genuine personal care and understanding of the recipient's perspective before the substantive critique can be received productively

allies.rationale_text: Auditability-traceability helps constructive-feedback-models stay specific by tying observations to documented behavior, standards, and consequences.
allies.affinity_rationale: Evidence grounding — 'document performance against clear criteria' — makes feedback defensible and specific by anchoring it to traceable evidence rather than subjective impressions.
allies.activation_condition: When feedback needs to be grounded in documented performance evidence against clear criteria rather than relying on subjective impressions or recollected incidents

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias makes constructive-feedback-models weaker by turning corrective evidence into something each side explains away instead of learning from.
antagonists.source_quote: demands openness to evidence that disconfirms one's current belief
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Blocks honest assessment — 'demands openness to evidence that disconfirms one's current assessment' — causes feedback givers and receivers to filter evidence through existing narratives about performance.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the feedback giver or receiver is filtering performance evidence through an existing narrative rather than genuinely engaging with data that disconfirms their current assessment

structured_tensions.tension_text: Constructive-feedback-models conflicts with authority-bias when feedback delivery is shaped by the giver's rank rather than the quality of the observation, causing recipients to comply rather than learn.
structured_tensions.source_quote: constructive-feedback-models conflicts with authority-bias (authority bias) when feedback delivery is shaped by the giver's rank rather than the quality of the observation, causing recipients to comply rather than learn.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Constructive-feedback-models conflicts with confirmation-bias when feedback is selectively delivered or received to confirm existing beliefs about performance rather than surface genuine deviation.
structured_tensions.source_quote: constructive-feedback-models conflicts with confirmation-bias (confirmation bias) when feedback is selectively delivered or received to confirm existing beliefs about performance rather than surface genuine deviation.

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. Allies: active-listening 0.80 (moderate — relational prerequisite), auditability-traceability 0.80 (moderate — evidence grounding). Antagonists: confirmation-bias 0.80 (moderate — blocks honest assessment). Activation conditions assigned. SPARSE_ALLY_RECOVERY: only 2 allies.
donor_drops: Did not widen into broad coaching ecosystems because the raw source is stronger on specific feedback mechanics and anti-defensiveness discipline.
open_questions: Metacognition is also a source-real ally, but active-listening and auditability-traceability were the more operational anchors.

SPARSE_ALLY_RECOVERY: only 2 allies curated. Psychological-safety and empathy are strong ally candidates for creating the conditions where constructive feedback is both given and received effectively.
